leadText: (Japanese: 柴田夏希 Natsuki Shibata) is a character in Aim to Be a Card Master!!, a manga series taking place in the real world. She is a friend of Kenta, the main character of the series. She advises Kenta to go to the in to find other players of the Pokémon Trading Card Game to challenge.
